title: 2D Parasternal Long-Axis Echocardiogram of Left Ventricle and Mitral Valve
author: Goleisureintl
caption: 2D parasternal long-axis (PLAX) transthoracic echocardiogram with color Doppler evaluating left ventricular function and valvular regurgitation.
alt_text: Echocardiogram in parasternal long-axis view showing left ventricle, left atrium, aortic root, and color Doppler jet.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates bedside cardiac ultrasound assessment of ventricular contractility and mechanical causes of cardiogenic shock (CLIFF-012, p.1, p.5-8).
